summary: Improve team coordination with practical training in GRPI, RACI, SMART goals and feedback. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: High-performance team training helps team leaders, supervisors and project leads diagnose team conditions, clarify ownership and improve coordination around shared work. Participants practise using Hackman’s model and GRPI to identify issues, mapping responsibilities and decision boundaries with RACI, and setting SMART goals. They also develop feedback and after-action review approaches to address obstacles and turn delivery evidence into team adjustments.
audienceIntro: This foundation-level course suits people who lead, coordinate or advise teams responsible for shared operational or project outcomes. It is designed for professionals who need to make work ownership visible and improve collaboration across roles.
prerequisites: Prior experience working in a team is useful for applying the exercises. No coding or programming is required.
